paragraphs.text: Gurias of Tolaria was a young wizard from the Smoke Mountains of Aerona , on Dominaria .

Gurias was a young man of average height and looks, with strawberry-blond curls and a limp moustache. He wore red hose and a doublet of brocaded blue, with a blue hat and red feather. He knew lightning bolt and paralysis, with limited knowledge of other spells. He carried a long knife and owned a cudgel he'd enchanted to beat people on its own.

Gurias claimed to be from Tolaria, though he had never visited it. He was the champion runner of his childhood village. Gurias was an apprentice of Tobias , an old wizard in the hills near the Smoke Mountains , but quickly grew bored with the study required. He descended into the valley below and began bullying the inhabitants of a village near the town of Bywater , demanding their money, food, and horses. When Greensleeves was alerted to Gurias's actions, she came to help the villagers and quickly subdued the inexperienced wizard, tagging him with the Stone Brain .

Later, he was one of the wizards who attacked Greensleeves's Grove. After seeing him kill Doris , one of her bodyguards, Greensleeves lost her temper and blasted him with a Ball Lightning . The lightning struck him full force, causing him to explode in a cloud of red smoke. His clothes, jewelry, hair, shoes, and even his Nova Pentacle were reduced to ashes within half a second, leaving only his skull intact.
